svg.text: SERENITY-CLASS TILTROTOR UAV · BUILD GUIDE · REV T+
2 lb/ft3 closed-cell PU, fore to aft
Procedure pending the Rev U re-audit of guide Phases 4-11 (graphical-build-guide/WBS.md 1.5.6).
This card shows the Rev U architecture only; follow the authority documents named below.
Never foam the nacelle interior, the spar passages, or the gear bays.
Cure fully before removing void formers; then fit the access-panel lids.
PU foam releases heat and vapor while curing. Work with ventilation, gloves, and eye protection.
